validity.researcher_notes: The Grand Chenier XPress Project is a compressor-station capacity expansion on ANR's existing system in Cameron Parish, Louisiana, not a new pipeline segment. FERC Docket No. CP20-8-000, ANR Pipeline Company, Notice of Application, published Federal Register Vol. 84, No. 219, Nov. 13, 2019 (FR Doc. 2019-24633): the project description names only the '(i) Grand Chenier Compressor Stations, (ii) ... compressor station (Mermentau Compressor Station), (iii) modifications ... and appurtenant and auxiliary facilities' -- no new mainline pipe segment is described anywhere in the notice. This is corroborated by TC Energy's own Grand Chenier XPress project fact sheet, which likewise describes the project as compressor-station modifications/additions to increase capacity on the existing ANR system, not new pipeline construction. The sheet's existing LengthKnownKm=0.00 is therefore already correct, and per standing protocol ('expansion with no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0, Diameter=blank'), the blank Diameter is the RIGHT answer, not a gap -- confirming it is the resolution to this flag.
